summary: FreightOS mock — agent completes booking flow through browser UI. v2: each search/services/quote/booking/verification/report sub-criterion is one atomic deterministic_exact check. No length checks. (task_id=browser-freightos-booking)
check_strategy: At runtime, freightos_v2.verify expands the full checks[] from booking-state + access-log + report. Declared checks below are illustrative — the verifier is the source of truth.

checks.description: state.authenticated == true AND access-log contains POST /login success.
Access-log shows valid uiToken POSTs to all of /search, /services, /select-quote, /confirm, /verification AND a verifier_token was injected.
8-9 atomic checks on state.searchData: origin/dest country+city, cargo type, container size+qty, goods value within $1000 of expected, non-hazardous (booking/booking-fastest).
3 atomic checks: insurance, customs, bond_type all match expected.
6-8 atomic checks: pickup/delivery company/contact/email/country match expected (task-specific).
4 structural checks on booking_confirmation.md: cites shipment_id, selected quote_id, seller name, includes ≥1 money/number figure. No length minimum.
